findings.text: defect (2) says the attempt marker at `reckon/crew/dispatch.py` near line 2772 "is dropped for a fresh launch whose node carries no brief" and that "before line 2772 only `_store_brief` (near line 2558) creates" the run directory, but `_publish_launch_claim` is called at dispatch.py:2582 for every non-shadow dispatch and writes `run_dir(run_id)/"claim.json"` through `runs._write_json` -> `write_json_atomically(create_parents=True)` (`reckon/_store.py:655`), which creates the directory first; a paired shadow's directory is already pre-created at dispatch.py:1353. Measured directly: monkeypatching `_supervisor_write` and running a brief-less fresh `crew.dispatch` (the tests' own `_dispatch` helper with `launcher=lambda: 4242`) records `attempt.json` written with `path.parent.is_dir() is True`, and the finished run directory holds `['attempt.json', 'claim.json', 'dispatch-detail.json', 'prompt.txt']` (probe log: /tmp/reckon-crew-scratch/r-20261109T152057570553-plan-review-of-a-run-has-one-live-worker/probe.log). So the marker is not dropped, "the plan-section launch loses it" is not true of the dispatch path, and the done-when case "the marker is written for a fresh launch with no brief" passes at the dispatch base and cannot be the failing-at-base case s16 requires
